title: The silent-undo scan may refuse a line reworded in place as a dropped line (degen #726, bulk-job line), so an honest edit costs a Drops-lines trailer and a new head
why: Sighting 09:26 CST Nov 15 (runner 11 via the coordinator, relayed 09:27; unproven, triage read neither the scan nor degen): degen #726 (head 5624a6114d72), `merge --confirm` refused by the silent-undo scan: "CLAUDE.md: merge a0bf1efdc drops 1 line(s) that parent c3e55fef4 added". The lane's remedy is the standing Drops-lines trailer commit plus a fresh review record on the new head; no bypass is proposed. Same class as done step silent-undo-inplace-rewrite (degen #706, 06:33 CST Nov 14, a one-sentence rewrite). Two sightings in two days, both in degen CLAUDE.md; rate unmeasured. First act of a lane: read the scan and the guard record, reproduce on the #726 diff, red then green, with a control that a real dropped line is still refused. A check change, so review round 3 applies. Related: silent-undo-appended-negation, silent-undo-restored-line, undo-scan-drops-lines.
